objectives.label: Tega lahko pobožate, tistega pa ne.
objectives.descriptorEN: Let people pet one dog, keep them off the other, and say why.

objectives.label: Počakaj! Naj te najprej povoha.
objectives.descriptorEN: Handle a child and her mother: yes, not today, or only the puppy.

objectives.label: Ali ga lahko pokličete?
objectives.descriptorEN: Get a loose dog called back, repeating louder or asking the owner to come.

objectives.label: Kar pojdite mimo, ju držim.
objectives.descriptorEN: Get past another dog on a narrow path, and explain your two.

objectives.label: Potem pa raje ne.
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask before the dogs meet, and accept a no.

objectives.label: Prosim, ne dajte mu več hrane. Pred kratkim je bil operiran.
objectives.descriptorEN: Turn down food for one or both dogs, even after it's too late.

objectives.label: Kaj pomeni ___? / Počasi, prosim. / Ponovite, prosim.
objectives.descriptorEN: Ask for help when someone talks fast.
